ribbon.about.title: About HermoPDF
ribbon.about.body: Everything happens on your computer; no internet connection is needed. HermoPDF never sends your files to any server and collects no usage data. If you turn on the optional Claude connection, the content Claude reads goes to Anthropic as part of your Claude conversation.
ribbon.about.oss: HermoPDF is open source (GPL-3.0). Open-source components used: pdf.js (Apache 2.0), pdf-lib (MIT), Tesseract.js (Apache 2.0), Lucide icons (ISC), Electron (MIT).

tour.open.title: Open or drag in a PDF
tour.open.body: Click here to choose a PDF, or drag files onto the window. Images and Word files work too; several PDFs open in separate tabs.
tour.ribbon.title: The ribbon: quick editing
tour.ribbon.body: The tools you use most live here: add text, highlight, sign and extract images. The tabs above hold page, conversion and protection tools.
tour.edit.title: Edit text directly
tour.edit.body: Choose "Edit text" and click any text on the page to change it in place. The font and size are kept wherever possible.
tour.compress.title: Compress PDF: to a target size
tour.compress.body: You can reduce the file size right here. Type the size you need (e.g. 2 MB) and HermoPDF finds the best quality that fits under that limit — ideal for email and upload limits.
tour.settings.title: Settings
tour.settings.body: Change the language and theme here — you can also restart this tour at any time.
tour.hint: You can see the tour again at any time from Settings > Restart the tour.

ocr.title: OCR — text recognition
ocr.whatIsBody: On scanned or photographed pages, the text is really just a picture. OCR reads the text in that picture and puts an invisible text layer on top of the page. The page's look never changes, but you can select the text with the mouse, copy it, search it with Ctrl+F, have it read aloud, or export it to Word.

OCR reads the text in the image and adds an invisible text layer on top of the page. The appearance does not change, but you can select, copy, search and read the text aloud.
assist.ocrProBody: Text recognition is part of HermoPDF Pro (one-time payment, no subscription). Reading, editing, compressing, merging, splitting and signing stay free.
protect.ownerPlaceholder: If left empty, the open password is used

protect.howBody: 1) On the Protect tab, choose the "Redact" tool. 2) Draw rectangles with the mouse over the places you want to hide (a black box appears). 3) Then come back here and press "Apply redaction". If you skip this step, the black box only sits on top; the text underneath stays in the file.

protect.flattenWhatBody: Text, signatures, form fields and comments you add to a PDF normally stay as "separate pieces": in other programs they can be moved or deleted, or a form field may look empty. Flattening makes them a permanent part of the page — everyone sees the same thing and nobody can tamper with it. Recommended before sending to official bodies, by email or to print.
protect.flattenWarn: After flattening, these items can no longer be edited. You can only undo with Ctrl+Z; once you save and close there is no way back. If you want to keep the original, use "Save as" first.
protect.flattenFormsNone: Flatten form fields (this document has no form fields)

protect.flattened: Document flattened — text and signatures are now part of the page. Don't forget to save.
protect.nothingToClean: There is no visible information to clean in this document (hidden XMP data may still exist).
protect.metaWhatBody: It is identifying information stored inside the PDF file that is not visible on the page but can be seen by anyone who opens the file: who prepared the document, with which program and when it was created, the computer or user name, and so on. You may want to remove these traces before sending the file outside (to a client, an agency, a tender).
protect.metaCleaned: Metadata cleaned. Don't forget to save.
protect.creator: Creator
protect.infoUpdated: Document info updated (don't forget to save)
protect.noFormHtml:
This document has no fillable form fields.

You can still fill it in: type anywhere with the Text tool, mark boxes with Check / Cross, or add a Signature.
protect.formsHelp: Fields can be filled in directly on the page. When you save, the values are written to the PDF. To make them uneditable, use "Flatten".
pro.featWorkflowsDesc: Save the steps you repeat often (e.g. merge → compress → watermark → password) once, then apply them with one click to the open document, to files you pick, or to every PDF in a folder.
pro.featOcrDesc: Make scanned pages and photos selectable, searchable and readable aloud — the whole document, chosen pages or a selected area. Runs entirely on your computer.
pro.featBatchDesc: Apply the same action (compress, OCR, watermark, page numbers, convert to images, merge, remove password) to many PDFs in one go.
pro.btnFree: HermoPDF Pro — one-time payment, no subscription
pro.lead: Pro adds OCR, batch processing and saved workflows. One-time payment, no subscription.
pro.freeNote: Reading, editing, compressing to a target size, merging, splitting, signing and basic conversions stay free.
pro.small: Purchases are made on our website; the app never asks for payment details. Pro helps keep HermoPDF ad-free and free to use.
pro.pricingOpened: The pricing page opened in your browser.

pro.errSandbox: This is a test (sandbox) license; it isn't valid in the official release of HermoPDF.
pro.errRevoked: This license has been revoked (usually after a refund or a payment dispute). If you think this is a mistake, contact our support team.
pro.errPlan: This license belongs to a plan this version doesn't recognize. Update the app and try again.

pro.successBody: Thank you! Your support keeps HermoPDF ad-free and independent. Your license is stored on this computer and works without an internet connection.

pro.revokedText: Your Pro license is no longer valid. This usually happens when a purchase is refunded or a payment is disputed (chargeback). All free features keep working. If you think this is a mistake, write to our support team and we'll sort it out together.
pro.aboutRevoked: Pro license revoked (refund / chargeback). Free features keep working.
pro.aboutInvalid: The stored license could not be verified.
pro.aboutFree: Free version — reading, editing, compressing, merging, splitting, signing and basic conversions; no ads.
update.explain: If you turn this on, HermoPDF downloads a small signed release file from our website at most once a day. No personal information is sent, but as with any web request, your IP address and app version are visible to the server. If you have a Pro license, the list of revoked licenses is downloaded the same way at most once a week.

batch.infoCompress: If you enter a target size, each file is compressed in steps until it gets below that size; if you leave it empty, the level you chose is applied.
batch.infoOcr: Scanned pages in each file are read and an invisible text layer is added. Takes a few seconds per page.
batch.infoImages: A separate folder is created for each PDF and the pages are written into it as JPEG files.
batch.infoMerge: Everything becomes a single PDF in the order of the list. You can change the order with the up/down arrows.

batch.title: Batch processing
batch.whatForBody: Instead of doing the same job file by file, this applies it to all the PDFs you select in one go. For example, compressing 30 scanned invoices in a row, or running OCR on all of them. Your original files are not changed; results are written as new files.
batch.ctrlA: To select every PDF in a folder, press Ctrl+A in the file picker.
batch.needTwo: You need at least two files to merge.
batch.outFolderTitle: Folder to save the results in
workflows.hintMerge: Can only be the first step. The files become one PDF in order; the following steps are applied to that file.

workflows.whatForBody: Save the steps you repeat often (e.g. merge → compress → watermark → password) once, then apply them with one click to the open document, to files you pick, or to every PDF in a folder. Your original files are not changed; results are written as new files.
workflows.proNoteBody: You can browse the templates. Running them and saving your own workflows requires Pro — one-time payment, no subscription.

claude.title: Claude connection
claude.consentIntro: With commands you type in Claude Desktop, you can have it read and edit the documents open in HermoPDF: summarize, search, highlight, rotate pages, compress…
claude.shareBody: Only what Claude asks for through its tools: page text, page images, search results and document names. This goes to Anthropic as part of YOUR Claude conversation and is subject to your Claude account's terms. HermoPDF does not send this content to its own servers or anywhere else. While the connection is off, Claude cannot access any document.
claude.feeBody: The connection is free. Claude usage counts against your own Claude plan.
claude.controlBody: Claude cannot overwrite a file or apply redaction on its own — you are asked whenever it wants to save or open another PDF file. Even with auto-save on, a document Claude has changed is not written to disk until you save it. Claude can only undo its own changes; every change can be undone with "Undo", and everything Claude does shows up in the Claude log in the status bar.
claude.warnBody: Text inside PDFs may try to mislead Claude. With documents you do not recognize, check the actions Claude suggests.
claude.openingBody: In the window that appears, click "Install". Then tell Claude something like "Summarize the PDF open in HermoPDF" or "Rotate page 3 to the right".
claude.missingBody: The Claude package is missing from this version. You can use the "Manual setup" steps below.
claude.notFoundBody: Claude Desktop does not seem to be installed on your computer. Download and install it first, then click this button again.
claude.copyFailed: Could not copy; the text is selected, press Ctrl+C to copy it.
claude.manualBody: In Claude Desktop → Settings → Developer → "Edit Config", add the following to the claude_desktop_config.json file that opens (if it already has other "mcpServers", just put the "hermopdf" section next to them), then restart Claude Desktop. You do not need to install Node.js: HermoPDF's own runtime is used.

claude.step2Body: This button opens the HermoPDF extension in Claude Desktop; you confirm the installation there. While HermoPDF is running and this connection is on, Claude can access your documents.
